svg.title: Разгибание пальцев с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Close-up dorsal view of two separate phases of the SAME single hand. One small elastic loop encircles ALL fingertips including thumb. Start fingers and thumb loosely bunched. Finish extend finger joints and spread tips modestly against the visibly stretched loop. Wrist neutral. Show forearm to fingers, five fingers only. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
